mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months compresses equity discount rates, producing statistically significant positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return distribution in periods with declining FEDFUNDS (over 3 months) shows no statistically significant positive mean (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.0% and remains above this threshold for 2 consecutive months, it triggers a monetary tightening cycle that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.0% for 2+ months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in residential housing starts (HOUST) above 890 thousand units and real personal consumption (RSAFS) above 420,000 million dollars indicates strengthening consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through elevated earnings expectations.
failure_condition: The joint signal (HOUST>890 and RSAFS>420000) fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime (UNRATE > 7.0%), a decline in the unemployment rate over the prior 3 months signals improving labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate profits, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return distribution in periods with UNRATE > 7.0% and declining UNRATE (over 3 months) shows no statistically significant positive mean (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the prior 3 months indicates expanding manufacturing output, which correlates with rising corporate earnings and produces positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return distribution in periods with rising INDPRO (over 3 months) shows no statistically significant positive mean (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When residential housing starts (HOUST) exceed 900 thousand units for at least 2 consecutive months, it signals immediate consumer demand strength that drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days through rapid market reaction.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where HOUST > 900 for 2+ months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 230), a federal funds rate above 2.0% triggers monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as valuation pressures accumulate.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns in periods meeting the trigger condition are positive in more than 40% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 7.5% and increase in employment (PAYEMS) above 136,000 thousand units indicates accelerating labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (UNRATE<7.5 and PAYEMS>136000) fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
